subject: quant

title.en: Gaussian processes and portfolios: bridge games
title.zh: 高斯过程与投资组合：桥接小游戏

en.a: A portfolio's covariance matrix and a GP's kernel matrix are the same object: portfolio variance, factor models, minimum-variance weights, shrinkage and Black–Litterman translate into GP conditioning.
en.b: An extension written for this site, not part of the Aalto course.

zh.a: 投资组合的协方差矩阵和 GP 的核矩阵是同一种对象：组合方差、因子模型、最小方差权重、收缩和 Black–Litterman 都可以翻译成 GP 条件化。
zh.b: 本站补充的扩展内容，不属于 Aalto 课程。

references: C. E. Rasmussen and C. K. I. Williams, Gaussian Processes for Machine Learning, MIT Press 2006, §2.2, §5.4.2, A.2
F. Black and R. Litterman, Global Portfolio Optimization, Financial Analysts Journal 48(5), 1992
O. Ledoit and M. Wolf, Honey, I Shrunk the Sample Covariance Matrix, Journal of Portfolio Management 30(4), 2004
G. V. G. Stevens, On the Inverse of the Covariance Matrix in Portfolio Analysis, Journal of Finance 53(5), 1998
